statement: We conjecture that it is possible to allow mixtures of EX- and AX-operators in vpRecCTL, achieving higher expressiveness and yet not losing decidability. We believe that satisfiability in such an extended fragment can also be reduced to the problem of solving a visibly-pushdown game [27].
context: n there is a path of length n such that all successive paths of that same length end in a q-state. This cannot be stated in PDL[VPL] even though it intuitively uses the VPL {an bn | n ≥ 1}, but PDL-based logics can only combine languages with a single modality. The property is, however, easily formalisable in RecCTL as EX(rec F(x).x ∨ EX F(AX x))(AX q). We conjecture that it is possible to allow mixtures of EX- and AX-operators in vpRecCTL, achieving higher expressiveness and yet not losing decidability. We believe that satisfiability in such an extended fragment can also be reduced to the problem of solving a visibly-pushdown game [27].
